description: n8n 2.41.7 in queue mode: its main process and its worker, the agent workflow's execution (a Code node that acts once a second, held by the worker as a queue job), a sub-workflow execution it started without waiting for it, and a published workflow with a Schedule Trigger every minute. Code nodes can reach only HTTP, so every action goes to the HTTP stand-in and is placed by its arrival. The delivery bound, 0.25 s, is about six times the largest delay a probe measured on 29 Oct (38.5 ms over 158 effects, from each Code node's Date.now() to its arrival); every run measures it again (record effects.delivery_wall_s). A Code node's end hook did not report when n8n aborted it (the probe), so the truth can show such work acting, never its end: its readings after an end are indefinite. The components report their processes to the truth before they become n8n (beat.py exec). Grace is 1.5 s (one and a half of the work's periods); the effect surface looks back 5 s, so checks start 10 s after the cut-off; the last check, 120 s after it, falls before n8n's 300 s task timeout ends an execution that went on. The restart action stops n8n's worker and main process and starts both again.
restart_action: n8n's worker and main process stopped and started again, each waited for until ready
